Binary Stream is a global Microsoft Gold-Certified ISV specialising in cloud-based ERP and financial solutions built on Microsoft Dynamics. Our products help organisations simplify complex accounting and operational processes while scaling efficiently.
 Experience: 2–4 Years
 Location: Chandigarh (Currently Remote)
 Role Overview
 We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have experience in manual testing, defect tracking, SQL validation, and working within Agile environments. You will collaborate closely with developers and product teams to ensure high-quality software delivery.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Create and execute test cases and test scenarios

• Perform functional, regression, integration, and usability testing

• Identify, document, and track defects

• Conduct backend/database testing using SQL queries

• Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot issues

• Participate in Agile ceremonies and QA process improvements

• Support automation testing initiatives where applicable

 Required Skills:

• 2–4 years of software testing/QA experience

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies and SDLC/STLC

• Experience with manual testing and defect management tools

• Basic understanding of automation testing

• Hands-on SQL/database testing experience

• Good communication and analytical skills

 Good to Have

• ERP or financial application testing experience

• Exposure to API testing tools like Postman

• Knowledge of Selenium or automation frameworks

 Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

 What We’re Looking For

• Strong problem-solving mindset and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• Continuous learner with a focus on improving systems and processes.

 Why Join Binary Stream ?

• Work with a global product-based company

• Collaborative and supportive team culture

• Flexible work environment

• Learning and growth opportunities

• Health benefits and employee-focused policies

• Exposure to enterprise-level ERP products and technologies
